moat_type: IP leadership in programmable logic devices
primary_risk: Dependence on a few large customers
sector_survival_note: The semiconductor industry is highly competitive and subject to rapid technological change, which may lead to disruption of market leaders.
thesis_summary: Lattice Semiconductor's programmable logic devices ride the trend of increasing demand for artificial intelligence and machine learning.
thesis_breaks_if: Acquisition or significant change in business strategy
sentiment_note: Rich valuation, but a great company with a strong moat
ten_k_highlights: The Company's net sales for the year ended December 31, 2022, were $574.0 million, an increase of 42.2% from $404.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2021.
The Company's gross margin for the year ended December 31, 2022, was 68.2%, compared to 64.5% for the year ended December 31, 2021.
The Company's research and development expenses for the year ended December 31, 2022, were $123.8 million, an increase of 44.1% from $86.1 million for the year ended December 31, 2021.
valuation_note: FCF yield 0.7%, PEG 0.6, EV/EBITDA 266, P/S 33 — very richly valued — starter position only.
implied_growth_note: The price assumes near-perfect execution for a decade — start small.
priced_for_perfection_note: Price already assumes ~34%/yr growth for a decade — start small, add on weakness
